intro: Being offline isn’t about running away from life. It’s about making time to connect, with each other and with ourselves. Offline moments are special, and we want them to be part of our everyday life, not just once in a while. In a world chasing speed, individual success, and constant connection, we choose to slow down. We believe in the power of community — a place to learn, grow, move, share, and create. A space where these things can happen naturally, openly, and together.
outro: And we want to share it with you.

pillars.title: LET’S EXPLORE TOGETHER
pillars.text: Trips, both near and far, that bring people together through shared experience. Whether it’s a weekend escape or a bigger adventure, it’s all about discovery — of places, of people, of perspectives.

pillars.title: MOVE & FEEL ALIVE
pillars.text: No pressure, no experts needed — just movement and good energy. Show up, move your body, and feel alive.

pillars.title: LET’S LEARN & CREATE
pillars.text: We connect beginners with professionals, offering space, tools, and support to create and explore. It’s all about sharing knowledge and inspiration.

pillars.title: COME EAT WITH US
pillars.text: A curated food experience — sometimes part of a trip, sometimes after a workshop. Always delicious. Always about more than just the food.

pillars.title: LET’S WATCH TOGETHER
pillars.text: Let’s watch films together, not alone. Regular screenings, real conversations, shared opinions. Just like the old days, but better.
